name: quote-card-builder-web
description: Create editable quote cards with model-designed ribbon compositions, reusable bases, and a hosted MCP editor.

interface.longDescription: Design three ribbon compositions with the model, choose and refine them in the hosted editor, save a personal base, and download PNG. Supports 4:5, 1:1 and 9:16. Visual warnings are descriptive and do not block export. Saved bases are local to the client; JSON export supports explicit reuse elsewhere.
interface.defaultPrompt: Crea tre composizioni Nastri per questa citazione e apri l’editor.
